name: Report Designer
description:
Users design report templates in the page and generate them as PDF, Word and Excel files from your data.

Source: any region source (SQL query, table or REST source). Its rows are the report data; Page Items to Submit and Faceted Search filters apply. Designer: drag blocks onto the page (heading, text, fields, table, image, line, space, page break), click a block to edit it, insert fields such as {CUSTOMER} or totals such as {SUM:AMOUNT|currency}. Tables have column formats, totals, row groups with subtotals, striped rows and borders. The report can make one section per value of a column (for example one invoice per order), each on a new page and, in Excel, on its own sheet. Page size, orientation, margins, colors, logo, header and footer with page numbers, date format and currency symbol. Templates are saved in a table (default TX_REPORT_TEMPLATES, see the Reference page for the script), per Template Group and Owner; shared templates can be used by everyone and copied with Save As. Report mode shows the saved templates with a preview and download buttons only.

Live demo: sign in as demo with the password Demo.

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later.
